title: Pseudocode ar Flowchart
learningObjectives: Algorithm ren step-ko saral ar porha jog akte re lekha bhasha-nirapeksh upay-ko Pseudocode menak kana, bujhaw.
Executable Code lekha age solution ren yojona, alochona, janch ar sudhar re Pseudocode ren bhumika bujhaw.
Algorithm, Pseudocode, Flowchart ar Program ren bhed ar sambandh chinaha.
Solution lekha age goal, Input, expected Output, dharana ar sima chinaha.
Nirdesh-ko tarkik kram re doho ar artha-purn nam beohar.
START, INPUT, OUTPUT, SET, IF, ELSE, WHILE, FOR ar STOP keywords thik beohar.
Input emte thik kram re ganana ar result udubena Pseudocode lekha.
IF/ELSE leka condition ar pratyek result ren kaj udubena.
WHILE/FOR leka dohoraw ar Loop control condition udubena.
Arambh value, variable update ar rukaw condition bujhi anant Loop roka.
Namuna Input leka Pseudocode hat re trace kore pratyek step ren value ar decision lekha.
Aspasht nirdesh, chhut step, bemel nam ar bhul block kram sudhara.
Flowchart ar onkar symbol ar arrow ren artha bujhaw.
Start/End, Process, Input/Output, Decision ar Arrow symbol chinaha.
Start khon End talak thik kram ren Flowchart banaw ba porhaw.
Decision Diamond ar Yes/No branch udubena.
Loop ren phir aṛe ar bahre nirkal path udubena.
Pseudocode-ko Flowchart re ar Flowchart-ko Pseudocode re badal.
Reader ba kaj khatir Pseudocode ba Flowchart modre kon safa, onka bachaw.
Dui representation re ohi logic, branch, Loop ses ar expected result janch.

understand.concept: Pseudocode do Algorithm renag bhabna ar step-ko porha leka leka lekha reya. Ona mit Programming Language ren Syntax re nirbhar kana. Flowchart ona eked solution-ko nirdharit akar ar arrow leka citra re udubena.
understand.whyItMatters: Pseudocode leka Syntax re cintā akana logic re monojog doho sakam. Flowchart step ren kram, decision branch ar Loop ren phir aṛe path-ko udubena.

explain.narrative: Pseudocode do Algorithm renag bhabna ar step-ko porha leka leka lekha reya. Ona mit Programming Language ren Syntax re nirbhar kana. Flowchart ona eked solution-ko nirdharit akar ar arrow leka citra re udubena.

examples.code:
Bhabna: Pseudocode ar sohoj Flowchart
Mit' chhot somossa chin'hao
Dhaap kram re lekha
Fol jachao
examples.explanation: Ona bhabna bujhaw khatir mit udaharan kana; pura calak Program na. Pahile samasya chinaha, step-ko kram re lekha ar result jacha.
examples.expectedOutput: Safa step ar bujhaw jog result.

examples.code:
START
INPUT number
IF number MOD 2 = 0 THEN
  OUTPUT "jora"
ELSE
  OUTPUT "bejor"
END IF
STOP
examples.explanation: IF mit condition janchao. Dui branch majhi mit khon follow hoy. Remainder zero menak khan Even, nole Odd branch bachaw hoy.

examples.code:
START
SET count = 1
WHILE count <= 3
  OUTPUT count
  SET count = count + 1
END WHILE
STOP
examples.explanation: Loop suru age count re arambh value deya hoy ar Loop bhitre badhao hoy. count 4 hoile condition false hoy ar Loop ses hoy. Update na hoile agun barhao kana.

examples.code:
(Oval) Etohob → (Parallelogram) Number lekha → (Diamond) Number >= 40 kana?
Hẽ → (Parallelogram) Pass → (Oval) Mund
Bã → (Parallelogram) Dohra chesta → (Oval) Mund
examples.explanation: Oval Start/End, Parallelogram Input/Output, Diamond Decision ar arrow disha udubena. Dui decision branch ren agla step ar ses saf menak kana.
examples.expectedOutput: 65 kana Hẽ path re Pass; 32 kana Bã path re dohra chesta.

practise.guidedTask: Bar number emte onko jog phal udubena Pseudocode lekha. Start, Input, Process, Output ar End menak Flowchart banawa.
practise.independentTask: Mit number Positive, Negative ba Zero kana chinahaw solution banawa. Pseudocode lekha, Yes/No branch leka Flowchart banawa ar tin case janch.
hints: Aage goal, Input ar expected Output lekha.
Pratyek instruction re mit safa kaj doho.
Sadharan step khatir Sequence, decision khatir IF/ELSE, repeat khatir WHILE/FOR beohar.
Flowchart symbol-ko onkar thik artha leka bachaw.
Pratyek Loop ren phir aṛe ar bahre nirkal path checka.
